negotiation: host.info returns feature only when picker transport is operational for this exact session and window
host.capabilities includes files.local.import only after host approval of the installed manifest and current session
SDK checks both before enabling pick; host rechecks on every operation
host.info.mode is embedded or detached; detached uses host-supplied authenticated message transport, never assumed window.parent
absence, unsupported feature version or revoked permission fails closed

requirements: User click or host-owned native confirmation before opening picker
requested filters and maxBytes must be subsets of manifest.fileImports
host enforces file size, extension and MIME policy with platform-specific MIME fallback
return basename only, never absolute paths or content URIs
Read only previously selected handle in current app session
host bounds length to <=65536 and validates offset/bytesRead
no directory or arbitrary path reads
Invalidate handle, clear host buffers, idempotent within session
Only cancel own pending picker request
If native UI cannot be closed, mark pending operation cancelled and discard any eventual selected result

security: No manifest grant based on app ID, extension cannot enumerate files
Tavi host owns native chooser on the correct embedded/detached window; Android ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT CATEGORY_OPENABLE with scoped temporary URI access, Windows native dialog
Do not persist selected handles, filesystem paths, content URIs or unrestricted grants
Close handles on app unmount, account change, permission revoke, timeout or window close
Host enforces 128MiB ceiling and 64KiB read ceiling and may advertise stricter runtime limits
No registry upload or publication; separate assets.registry.admin/v1 authorization required
Treat selected file as untrusted data; Tavi Assets validates .tavia content
Picker filters are UI hints, not proof of safe content; verify type, size and package contents
Host response origin/session binding must be authenticated; detached transport must not trust arbitrary opener windows
